archetypes.name: The Quiet Architect
archetypes.oneLiner: You've been building entire cities in your head and wondering why nobody visits.
archetypes.pattern: Builds worlds internally but rarely shows them

archetypes.name: The Signal Keeper
archetypes.oneLiner: You've been tuning everyone else's frequency so long, you forgot what yours sounds like.
archetypes.pattern: Highly attuned to others but neglects own signal

archetypes.name: The Fracture Point
archetypes.oneLiner: The crack isn't where you're breaking — it's where the light you've been hiding is finally getting out.
archetypes.pattern: Near a breaking point, holding it together externally

archetypes.name: The Ghost in the Room
archetypes.oneLiner: You're not invisible. You're just standing in a room full of people who forgot how to look.

archetypes.name: The Mirror Walker
archetypes.oneLiner: You've been looking at yourself through everyone else's mirror. No wonder nothing looks right.
archetypes.pattern: Sees themselves through others' eyes, struggles with identity

archetypes.name: The Anchor
archetypes.oneLiner: Being grounded doesn't mean being buried. You can be rooted and still grow.
archetypes.pattern: Grounded but stuck, feels stable but unfulfilled

archetypes.name: The Echo
archetypes.oneLiner: The loop isn't punishment. It's your system asking you to hear the part you keep skipping.
archetypes.pattern: Repeats patterns, feels stuck in loops

archetypes.name: The Edge Walker
archetypes.oneLiner: You've been standing at the edge so long, you forgot that falling and flying use the same motion.
archetypes.pattern: Lives on the edge of change, afraid to step over

archetypes.name: The Spark
archetypes.oneLiner: You're not scattered. You're a supernova that hasn't decided which direction to explode yet.
archetypes.pattern: Bright energy but scattered, needs focus

archetypes.name: The Witness
archetypes.oneLiner: You've been watching life like it's a movie. At some point, the screen has to become a door.

ctas.text: This is Layer 1. There are six more.
The Map shows you where you operate. The Reset shows you why you got stuck.
Your full perception map is coming soon.
